title: Finite etale-origin site comparison preserves the exceptional base-change mate
statement:
Fix the finite-field and coefficient data of [def-pur-conventions]: $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ has characteristic $p_0$, $\ell\ne p_0$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, $n\geq1$, and $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$. Let $X,Y,Y'$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes and let $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y'\to Y$ be $k$-morphisms, with $f$ separated of finite type [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Form the Cartesian square [def-cbc-compact-support-square] with $X'=X\times_Y Y'$, $g_X:X'\to X$ and $f':X'\to Y'$. Choose a compactification $c=(j,r)$, $X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{r}Y$, with $j$ open and $r$ proper, and its pullback $c'=(j',r')$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Assume that $\overline X$ and $\overline X'=\overline X\times_Y Y'$ are finite-type $k$-schemes and that $\dim\overline X\leq d$, $\dim\overline X'\leq d'$ for integers $d,d'\geq0$, with dimension as in [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension].

Use ordinary constant-$A$ module derived categories on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Write $C_T=\nu_T^*$ for exact derived comparison pullback [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback]. Put $F=Rr_{\mathrm{et},*}j_!^{\mathrm{et}}$, $F'=Rr'_{\mathrm{et},*}j'_!^{\mathrm{et}}$, using [def-amb-etale-compact-support], and let $R=f_c^\times$, $R'=f_{c'}'^\times$ be their ordinary etale right adjoints [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint], with counits $\epsilon^e,\epsilon'^e$. Put $P=Rf_!^c$, $P'=Rf'_!^{c'}$ for pro-etale compact supports [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], and $H=C_XR R\nu_{Y,*}$, $H'=C_{X'}R'R\nu_{Y',*}$ for the finite exceptional functors [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], with the bounded-below etale-origin Hom bijections of [thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class]. For every morphism $u:T'\to T$ write
$$\kappa_u:C_{T'}u_{\mathrm{et}}^*\xrightarrow{\sim}Lu_{\mathrm{proet}}^*C_T$$
for the canonical inverse-image comparison [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback]. For $L\in D^+(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, let
$$h_{f,L}:C_XRL\xrightarrow{\sim}HC_YL$$
be $C_XR$ applied to the site-comparison unit $L\xrightarrow{\sim}R\nu_{Y,*}C_YL$ of [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison]; define $h_{f',-}$ in the same way.

Let $B^e:g_{\mathrm{et}}^*F\xrightarrow{\sim}F'g_{X,\mathrm{et}}^*$ be the compact-support exchange of [def-cbc-exchange-map, thm-cbc-finite-torsion] and $B^p:Lg_{\mathrm{proet}}^*P\xrightarrow{\sim}P'Lg_{X,\mathrm{proet}}^*$ its transported exchange on bounded-below etale-origin inputs [thm-cbc-finite-level-proetale]. Let $\beta^e_L:g_{X,\mathrm{et}}^*RL\to R'g_{\mathrm{et}}^*L$ be the $F'\dashv R'$ transpose of
$$g_{\mathrm{et}}^*(\epsilon^e_L)\circ(B^e_{RL})^{-1}.$$
Let $\epsilon^p_{C_YL}:PHC_YL\to C_YL$ be the map corresponding to $1_{HC_YL}$ under the relative Hom bijection for $P,H$. Define $\beta^p_{C_YL}:Lg_{X,\mathrm{proet}}^*HC_YL\to H'Lg_{\mathrm{proet}}^*C_YL$ to be the relative $P',H'$ transpose of
$$Lg_{\mathrm{proet}}^*(\epsilon^p_{C_YL})\circ(B^p_{HC_YL})^{-1}.$$
These are the counit-transpose mates of inverse compact-support exchange, as in [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. All inputs in these formulas are bounded below and, when required as source inputs of the relative Hom bijections, of etale origin.

Define the endpoint isomorphisms
$$v_L=\kappa_{g_X,RL}^{-1}\circ Lg_{X,\mathrm{proet}}^*(h_{f,L}^{-1}):Lg_{X,\mathrm{proet}}^*HC_YL\xrightarrow{\sim}C_{X'}g_{X,\mathrm{et}}^*RL,$$
$$w_L=h_{f',g_{\mathrm{et}}^*L}^{-1}\circ H'(\kappa_{g,L}^{-1}):H'Lg_{\mathrm{proet}}^*C_YL\xrightarrow{\sim}C_{X'}R'g_{\mathrm{et}}^*L.$$
Then the actual exceptional mates satisfy
$$w_L\circ\beta^p_{C_YL}=C_{X'}(\beta^e_L)\circ v_L.$$
The equality is natural in $L$ and is preserved by replacing $C_YL$ with an isomorphic witnessed input. No isomorphy of $\beta^e$ or $\beta^p$, smoothness of $f$, or unrestricted pro-etale adjunction is assumed.
